message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.62,"fairness_assessment":"All three options address legitimate club objectives, but the evidence is incomplete and no option clearly dominates; a transparent preference vote with agreed criteria would treat competing priorities fairly.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"agent_1","position":"Favors allocating the full budget to an inter-city tournament with buffet and prizes to increase the club’s visibility.","influence":0.33},{"agent":"agent_2","position":"Favors investing the full budget in educational equipment and new chessboards to strengthen ongoing club activities.","influence":0.33},{"agent":"agent_3","position":"Favors splitting the budget equally between a smaller tournament and equipment, seeking balance between visibility and internal development.","influence":0.34}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"Use a ranked social-choice process after comparing options against agreed criteria such as durable benefit, participation impact, visibility, and budget risk. A conditional compromise is appropriate: adopt a hybrid allocation only if minimum viable funding for both activities is established, with a review after the tournament to assess outcomes and adjust future spending."}
